_meta.population: aiperf profile_export.jsonl(.gz) records with benchmark_phase == 'profiling' and was_cancelled == false, all 16 runs of results/k31vr-frozen-sweep-20261114 that kept the per-request export (C512 kept only the summary). Pooled = all records of those runs (dominated by C>=96).
_meta.dataset: semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126 (AgentX 'agentx profile', duration 3600 s, closed loop)
_meta.units: tokens unless stated; s = seconds; B = bytes

same_conversation_turn_growth.note: negative values = context compaction/truncation between turns; the median new-input growth per follow-up turn is ~1.6K tokens, i.e. the measured fresh mean (5.46K) carries ~2-3x structural growth from partial-block tails, misses (12% zero-hit), and evictions

pooled.same_conversation_gap_note: next-turn start minus previous-turn end within one conversation_id; includes parent waits on subagents, so it is NOT the per-request think time; use closed_loop_idle_per_request_s

think_time.definition: C / lambda - mean request latency (Little's law per run): the idle time each of the C closed-loop session slots spends between a response and its next request
think_time.use: request rate per session slot = 1 / (idle + latency); in-flight requests = C x latency / (idle + latency) (30-40% of C at C>=96)

attention_work_note: mean_dense_attn_pairs_prefill = E[fresh*cached + fresh*(fresh+1)/2] (indexer logits per request); dense_pairs_per_fresh_token = average keys the indexer scores per fresh token; mean_sparse_attn_pairs_prefill_topk2048 = E[sum over fresh tokens of min(ctx, 2048)] (~2003 per fresh token); decode_ctx_per_output_token_mean = E[sum over output tokens of ctx]/E[OSL]
prefill_engines_note: steady state = last 75% of the 10 s logger windows. local_hbm_prefix_hit_pct = vLLM 'Prefix cache hit rate' (HBM); external = 'External prefix cache hit rate' (Mooncake, % of tokens not hit locally that were found). Prompt tok/s is computed (fresh) tokens.

prefill_scheduling.note: only the C512 prefill logs carry the per-window 'DCP ShardQ prefill ... steps, tokens' counter: ~15.2-15.9K tokens per step (mean), ~2.1 steps/s per DP4 engine at mnbt 32768. TP8 prefill runs pack chunks up to 16384 tokens; fresh token mass is 50% in requests with > 16K fresh tokens, so long requests split into 16K/32K chunks while the 81% of requests with < 4K fresh tokens share a step.

kv_state_bytes._note: All bytes are for the whole model and one request/token, before any sharding. B = bytes. Layer counts from release config.json text_config: dsa_config.dsa_layers (24, 1-based 4..92,93) and linear_attn_config.kda_layers (69).

mla_latent_fp8_standard.layout: kv_lora 512 + rope 64, all FP8 E4M3, one per-tensor scale (no per-token scale)
mla_latent_fp8_standard.source: vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/mla.py get_kv_cache_spec (state_content_bytes None unless fp8_ds_mla); engine logs 'Using standard fp8 KV cache format'; decode NIXL log 'arrays 24 x row 576 B'; block_len 589824 = 1024 x 576

indexer_key_mxfp4.layout: index_head_dim 128 as FP4 E2M1 (64 B) + 4 UE8M0 scales (block 32)
indexer_key_mxfp4.source: release decode NIXL log 'arrays ... 24 x index_value 64 B, 24 x index_scale 4 B'; block_len 69632 = 1024 x 68

alt_mla_fp8_ds_mla.layout: 512 FP8 + 4 x FP32 scales + 64 BF16 rope

alt_indexer_fp8.layout: 128 FP8 + FP32 scale (DeepSeek V3.2 indexer cache format)

dsa_kv_per_token_all_layers.deployed_packed_row_note: release decode logs: '1024-row blocks 15980544 B apart' (24 x (576+64+4) x 1024 = 15,826,944 + 153,600 B per row block = +150 B/token packing slack, ~1%)

recurrent_fp32.source: mamba_utils.py kda_state_shape/kda_state_dtype (mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float32); logs mamba_ssm_size 393216 per rank at TP16 = 6 heads

conv_window_fp32_sol.note: SOL / user rule: FP32 conv state, window = conv_kernel-1 = 3 columns

conv_with_spec_cols_fp32.note: kda_state_shape widens the conv state to 3 + num_spec columns

conv_deployed_bf16_with_spec_cols.source: deployed mamba_cache_dtype=auto -> BF16 (model dtype); logs mamba_ssm_size conv 46080 B/rank at TP16 k7 = 2304 ch x 10 x 2 B, 110592 at TP4 k3 = 9216 x 6 x 2

kda_state_per_request_all_layers.deployed_resident_note: mamba_cache_mode=align (prefix caching on) keeps 2 + num_speculative_blocks (=k unless use_replayssm) + num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks (1) page sets per request (v1/kv_cache_interface.py MambaSpec.max_memory_usage_bytes; model_executor/layers/mamba/abstract.py). use_replayssm=False by default (vllm/config/cache.py:380). A SOL design keeps 1 state (+ replay/recompute of the verify window); per-token verify states would be (1+k) sets.

drafter_swa_kv.layout: 5 layers x 16 KV heads x 64 x (K,V) x BF16
drafter_swa_kv.deployed_bound_note: window + FA2 key-tile slack (tile 256 - hit unit 64, gqa_draft.py _hit_unit_block) + one 128-token page; k+1 verify rows ignored
drafter_swa_kv.source: DSpark e4e6e626 config.json (num_key_value_heads 16, head_dim 64, sliding_window 2048, 5 layers, bf16); release decode logs block_len 32768 = 128 tok x 1 KV head/rank x 64 x 2 x 2 B at TP16 ('GqaWindow on 128-token pages')
drafter_swa_kv.frozen_sweep_note: the 20261114 frozen sweep used the preview MLA drafter (kimi-k3.1-pro-dspark-preview, TOKENSPEED_MLA), which keeps its own MLA cache (dense_draft.py); the release GQA drafter replaces it

sharding_rules.dsa_kv: stored once per DCP group, tokens interleaved across DCP ranks (cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 1); TP without DCP replicates the latent KV on every TP rank (MQA latent); DSA-DP (PRs #20/#23) stores it once per TP group on the owner card; DEP/DP attention: on the request's DP rank
sharding_rules.kda_state: sharded by heads across TP (96/TP heads per rank); replicated across DCP ranks that are not TP ranks (MambaSpec.max_num_blocks_per_req: never CP-sharded); under DP attention the whole state is on the request's rank
sharding_rules.drafter_kv: sharded by the 16 KV heads across TP up to 16; replicated beyond 16 (logs 'NIXL draft at DCP 1 (16 KV heads)')

deployed_capacity_reconciliation._note: vLLM logs 'GPU KV cache size' = num_blocks / blocks_per_request(at max_model_len 1,048,576) x 1,048,576 (v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py get_max_concurrency_for_kv_cache_config). Inverting it gives the pool rows a request takes beyond its DSA rows = the KDA/drafter state reservation of the deployed allocator.

decode_TP16_DCP16_k7_release_gqa_drafter.state_rows: 43 = 10 KDA page sets (align: 2 + k7 + 1 ckpt) x 4 rows + 3 drafter-window rows

decode_DP4_TP4_DCP4_k3_replayssm_C512.state_rows: 6 = 3 KDA page sets (align with use-replayssm: 2 + 0 + 1) x 2 rows
decode_DP4_TP4_DCP4_k3_replayssm_C512.source: frozen C512-a1093684 hecate0320_decode_w0.out; config.yaml decode 'use-replayssm: true'

deployed_capacity_reconciliation.takeaway: the deployed TP16 low-latency decode reserves ~11.0 GB of state per request (10.2 GB KDA in 40 rows + 0.77 GB drafter in 3 rows; 22x the 0.51 GB SOL state+drafter), more than the DSA KV of a 189K-token context (2.9 GB); the C512 replayssm config reserves ~1.8 GB. The SOL model should use kda_state_per_request_all_layers.sol_one_state_fp32_conv3 (+ drafter) and treat the deployed numbers as an implementation gap.

isl_mean.note: P->D pull of the whole prompt KV (cached + fresh) + final KDA state + drafter window; per fresh prefill token this is ISL/fresh = 26.6x the fresh-token KV

isl_p50.note: P->D pull of the whole prompt KV (cached + fresh) + final KDA state + drafter window; per fresh prefill token this is ISL/fresh = 26.6x the fresh-token KV

weights._note: Release Kimi-K3.1-Pro d9e99b07, bytes summed from every safetensors shard header (497,340 tensors). GB = 1e9 B. Sharding classes say how a topology divides each class.

sharding_class.moe_latent_up_down_norm_bf16: TP or replicated (per layer 7168x3584 up + 3584x7168 down)
sharding_class.moe_shared_experts_bf16: TP or replicated (2 shared experts fused: 6144 = 2 x 3072)
sharding_class.dsa_mla_attn_bf16: TP over heads for q_b/kv_b/o/g; q_a/kv_a replicated or TP (q_a 1536x7168, q_b 18432x1536, kv_a 576x7168, kv_b 24576x512, o 7168x12288, output gate g 12288x7168)
sharding_class.embed_tokens_bf16: vocab-parallel over TP or replicated (163840 x 7168)
sharding_class.vision_tower_and_projector_bf16: loaded by vLLM for the multimodal arch; not on the text path

C512 decode DP4 x TP4/DCP4 (16 GPUs)

hbm.note: non-torch includes NCCL/symmetric-memory buffers and the Mooncake/NIXL registrations; 'consumed' minus 'Model loading took' = non-torch + runtime buffers (~22-24 GiB decode TP16, ~12 GiB prefill TP8, ~15 GiB C512 prefill, ~101 GiB C512 decode incl. dloan/side buffers)
